q: The verifier asks why our emissions changed so much from last year. What do they want?
title: Explaining year-on-year change to a verifier
short: They want a short, evidenced reason for each large movement: more production, a fuel switch, a new machine, a corrected error or a changed factor. Prepare a table of last year versus this year by source, with the cause and the document behind each change.
audience: MSMEs with a second-year inventory under review

ul: Source, last year, this year, change.
Evidence: production report, invoice, purchase order or method note.
Switch from coal or diesel to gas or grid power.
Error found and corrected in last year's figure.

p: Say so and restate, rather than letting this year absorb the correction.

senseible: Senseible keeps each figure tied to its invoice, factor and method version, so a verifier can trace any number back to the document it came from.

sources.label: ISO 14064-3, verification of greenhouse gas statements
